biggest_catch: This is NOT $500 in cash or bitcoin — it is $500 of waived trading fees on bitcoin purchases. If Strike charges ~1% per trade, the real cash value is only a few dollars of fees saved.
catches: The reward is waived trading fees, not $500 cash or $500 in bitcoin — the actual dollar value is only the fees you would have paid on $500 of bitcoin trades.
Amounts are denominated in local currency (e.g., €500 in Europe); in some supported countries both sides receive $100 of fee-free trading instead.
The program does not apply to users in the UK.
Your friend must join Strike with your referral code and complete a bitcoin purchase (from deposited cash or a linked payment method).
Your fee-free $500 applies once your friend's bitcoin purchase completes; your friend's applies immediately to their first $500 of bitcoin trades.
The friend's reward applies to their next $500 of bitcoin trades (single trades, recurring purchases, or target orders, buying or selling).
There are no limits to the number of friends you can refer.

c2.evidence: Official strike.me referral FAQ states the $500 fee-free trading benefit for both sides, the first-bitcoin-purchase qualification, and no referral limit.

c3.evidence: No fee to participate; friend must buy bitcoin (amount not specified, so a small first purchase qualifies).

c4.evidence: Official page: 'you both receive $500 of bitcoin trading fee-free'. Honest disclosure: this is fee savings, not cash.

eligibility: Referrer: a Strike user with the app. Friend: a new user who signs up with the referrer's code and buys bitcoin. Not available in the UK; amounts vary by country in local currency ($100/$100 in some supported countries).

steps: Update the Strike app and open your Account screen.
Tap 'Invite friends, trade without fees' and copy your invite link or referral code.
Your friend downloads Strike and enters your referral code during signup.
Your friend completes signup, deposits cash or links a payment method, and buys bitcoin.
Your friend's first $500 of bitcoin trades are fee-free immediately.
Once your friend's bitcoin purchase completes, you get your next $500 of bitcoin trades fee-free.
Track status on your Account screen under 'Invite friends, trade without fees'.
